owner_posts.post_text:
Not every acne mark is a scar — and telling them apart is the difference between treatment that works and treatment that doesn't.

Post-acne redness, brown pigmentation and true atrophic scars can look similar but need entirely different protocols. Get the diagnosis right and the plan follows; get it wrong and you lose months. That's why every plan here begins with a close look from a qualified dermatologist.

Our Marine Lines clinic — India's first dedicated aesthetic practice, opened in 1993 — has a documented record going back decades, and we use it: 50 years of dermatology behind Dr. Sheth's informs how we read your skin and decide what each mark actually needs.

If you've been considering acne scar treatment near Marine Lines, book a consultation and start with the one thing that determines everything after it — an accurate diagnosis.

Hair loss has many causes, and the right treatment depends on identifying which one. At Dr. Sheth's Skin & Hair Clinics in Marine Lines, Mumbai (India's first dedicated aesthetic clinic, established 1993), hair loss is assessed by qualified dermatologists who look for the underlying cause before recommending treatment. Common causes include genetic patterning (androgenetic alopecia), thyroid and hormonal changes, nutritional deficiencies such as low iron or ferritin, post-illness or postpartum shedding (telogen effluvium), and scalp conditions like dandruff or seborrhoeic dermatitis. Each is treated differently, so a proper diagnosis (medical history, scalp examination and, where needed, blood work) is the first step, not a one-size prescription. Dr. Sheth's has cared for Mumbai's skin and hair for 50 years, and that documented clinical experience guides every hair-loss plan. If you're noticing thinning, increased shedding or a widening part, an early consultation gives the clearest path forward. Book a hair-loss consultation at our Marine Lines clinic.

Most people seek treatment for hair loss when thinning becomes clearly visible. By then, the underlying scalp condition — chronic inflammation, seborrhoeic dermatitis, follicular miniaturisation — has often been progressing unaddressed for months.

At Dr. Sheth's Skin & Hair Clinics, we see hair and scalp concerns at every stage: from persistent dandruff and early shedding that does not respond to over-the-counter products, to more advanced thinning that may require procedural treatment such as GFC, PRP, or, where appropriate, a hair transplant carried out in-clinic by a specialist surgeon.

If you have been managing recurring scalp issues or progressive hair loss, a structured dermatologist evaluation is usually more efficient than cycling through products that do not address the root cause.

Our clinic is open Monday through Saturday. New patients begin with a dermatologist consultation — we assess your specific condition before recommending any treatment.

You've probably heard a hundred reasons your hair is thinning. Stress. Diet. Genetics. The shampoo your mother used.
Each could be true. Most of the time, only one is.
At our clinic, the first thing we do for a hair concern isn't a treatment — it's an evaluation. A scalp examination, a pull test, density assessment. Where it's needed, blood work for thyroid, ferritin, vitamin D. A trichoscope when the eye can't tell the full story.
It sounds clinical. It's actually the difference between a year of treatment that works and a year of treatment that doesn't. Hair loss from genetics looks similar to hair loss from a shedding episode looks similar to a scarring condition. The treatments are not similar at all.
Once we know what we're treating, we can talk about what to do about it — medical management, regenerative therapies like GFC, PRP, exosomes, or a transplant referral when that's the right call.
Start with the evaluation. The plan follows.

Primelase and Triton lasers — effective on all Indian skin types including darker tones. Supervised by dermatologists. Consultations at Marine Lines, Juhu, and Chembur.
